_about: What PULSAR can do on the HUD, described for the model that picks one when the astronaut's words match no fixed phrase (backend/pulsar/hud_skill.py). `when` says in plain words which requests belong to the action, `examples` are phrases in Spanish and English, `cues` are the words that make a request worth asking the model about at all (it is not asked about anything else). `say` and `name` point into pulsar/hud_actions.py. Add an action here and it is offered to the model; the HUD side must handle its `action`.

relax_breathe.when: The astronaut wants to calm down, lower stress, anxiety, nerves or worry, slow down, wind down or breathe. Slow guided breathing.
relax_breathe.name: breathe

relax_eyes.when: The astronaut's eyes are tired, dry, sore or strained, from looking at screens or for a long time. Rest the eyes.
examples: I need to rest my eyes
relax_eyes.name: eyes

relax_body.when: The astronaut feels muscle tension or stiffness in the neck, shoulders, back, jaw, arms or hands, or wants to stretch or let the tension go. Body relaxation.
relax_body.name: body

relax_menu.when: The astronaut wants to relax, take a break or a pause, rest, disconnect or switch off, with no preference for which exercise. Opens the relaxation menu so they pick.

measure_form.when: The astronaut wants to type in or log measurements in general, without naming which one.
examples: I want to log my readings

measure_heart.when: The astronaut asks how or where to take their pulse or heart rate, or wants that measurement panel.
examples: how do I check my pulse
measure_heart.name: biometrics.heartRateBpm

measure_pressure.when: The astronaut asks how or where to take their blood pressure, or wants that measurement panel. Not for muscle tension.
examples: how do I take my blood pressure
measure_pressure.name: selfReport.bloodPressure

measure_glucose.when: The astronaut asks about blood sugar or glucose, or how to measure it.
measure_glucose.name: selfReport.glucoseMgDl

measure_temperature.when: The astronaut asks about body temperature or fever, or how to take it.
measure_temperature.name: selfReport.bodyTempC

measure_sleep.when: The astronaut asks about their sleep, hours slept, or how to log it.
measure_sleep.name: selfReport.sleepHoursLast24h

measure_mood.when: The astronaut wants to log or check their mood or how they feel emotionally.
measure_mood.name: selfReport.mood

habits_open.when: The astronaut wants to see their daily habits panel: exercise, water, sleep and relaxation of today.

habits_history.when: The astronaut wants the history, the month view or the charts of their habits.

close_panels.when: The astronaut wants to close, hide or clear the open windows and panels.
